friction_notes: 31:10 is part of the declared 1–11 pericope. It cannot alone supply a global trigger; the water analogy uses 31:34 as its wider extension and remains exploratory.

The 31:16/20/34 hidden-scale synthesis is an attributed inference. The supplied caution that it may be a reconstructed arc remains live, and the 31:34 connection says the unseen-knowledge image is not itself the creation proof.
The 31:13 association-as-wrongdoing relation covers more than creative authorship. Applying it to the focus's creator-credit dispute is a bounded inference, not an exhaustive account of wrongdoing.
The 31:30 falsehood judgment may address worship generally; the cross-examination reading is not a claim that every later falsehood is specifically a creator claim.
The 31:32 crisis sequence supports an attributed stress-test of reliance but is explicitly not creation proof. The 31:27 inscription contrast is nearby majestic context, not a direct focus argument.
Water-to-growth, reservoir, inscription, and nontransferable-role readings remain exploratory analogies. The R-W-Y water-carrying branch is excluded from the focus RʾY show form.
The proximate-cause reading of dun remains viable but less direct according to an unanchored summary; no global trigger here ranks it against the supplied other-than branch.
HFT context word indices, roots, and roles without independent registry records remain attributed; exact supplied Arabic anchors verify surface presence but do not supply missing morphology.
